> **Key Biological Concepts**  
> - **Carrying Capacity (K):** Maximum population size the environment can sustain.  
> - **Reproduction Rule Used:** After harvest, the population **doubles** up to a cap of **30** (our K).  
> - **Maximum Sustainable Yield (MSY):** The largest long-term average catch that can be taken without depleting the population (often near ~½ K in simple logistic models).
